evidence_class: post-RT1 mechanistic follow-up on already-observed SCORPION data; not independent confirmation and not a promotion experiment
motivation: RT1 failed only the held-out biological-alignment gate while operator-only transport, scanner-probe reduction, retrieval noninferiority, exact invertibility, and matched capacity passed. A read-only audit showed candidate/control held-out calibration losses and held-out operator-only transport were numerically identical, yet latent alignment diverged by scanner. RT2 tests whether the divergence is caused by differential encoder sensitivity to the same post-transport residual.
scientific_question: For the actual held-out scanner residual r = T_h^-1(x_h) - x_0, does the inverse-transport candidate encoder produce a larger latent displacement than the no-inverse control encoder when both encoders receive the identical residualized observation x_0 + r?

dataset.name: SCORPION
dataset.manifest_binding: Use the frozen pre-outcome semantic manifest identity rule from RT1; raw CSV byte identity is provenance-only.

preprocessing.fit_scope: AT2 train rows only, separately within each fold

training.heldout_operator_calibration_updates: heldout operator only, on val slides
training.fresh_seed_rule: RT1 seeds 4701-4703 are burned and are not reused.

encoder_conditions: candidate encoder E_c evaluated on x_0, x_0+r, and x_h
control encoder E_x evaluated on x_0, x_0+r, and x_h

matched_random_direction_probe.construction: Gaussian directions normalized per region to the RMS norm of r; identical directions supplied to candidate and control encoders
matched_random_direction_probe.metric: mean directional Jacobian gain across the 16 matched random directions

mechanistic_probe.heldout_operator_identity_check: After calibration, candidate/control heldout operator parameters and residual tensors must agree to <=1e-7 within each fold/holdout/seed cell; otherwise the mechanistic comparison fails closed.

primary_endpoint.name: candidate_minus_control_same_residual_finite_sensitivity
primary_endpoint.aggregation: average regions within slide, average fresh model seeds within fold/holdout/slide, then average the four preregistered scanner holdouts within each of the 48 slides
primary_endpoint.support_rule: encoder-residual amplification is supported if the lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound is > 0

metrics: residual-direction specificity interaction = (candidate-control residual JVP gain) - (candidate-control random JVP gain)
candidate and control raw-displacement finite sensitivity
canonicalization benefit within each encoder = raw finite sensitivity - residual finite sensitivity
fresh-seed reproduction of the RT1 heldout alignment direction as descriptive context

interpretation_tree.primary_positive_and_jvp_positive_and_sp: supports residual-direction-specific local encoder amplification after otherwise-successful transport
interpretation_tree.primary_positive_and_jvp_positive_but_sp: supports broader local sensitivity amplification rather than residual-direction specificity
interpretation_tree.primary_positive_but_jvp_not_positive: supports finite/nonlinear or off-reference amplification not captured by the local Jacobian
interpretation_tree.primary_not_positive: does not support differential same-residual encoder sensitivity as the explanation for RT1; do not repair the encoder on this basis

claim_boundary: RT2 can only localize the already-observed RT1 SCORPION failure. It cannot rescue RT1, cannot establish external validity, cannot select a favorable scanner subset, and cannot be treated as independent confirmation. Any architectural successor motivated by RT2 requires a separately frozen prospective protocol.
